item.case_name: Mood or music piece, no dialogue
item.title: Quiet After the Rain

turns.text: Make a 10-second widescreen mood film: a lonely bus stop after rain, late at night. Melancholy but peaceful, with gentle movement. Completely silent, no dialogue or text.

item.tests: Tests whether a short silent film conveys a specified mood through imagery, lighting and movement rather than dialogue or explanatory text.

answer_sheet.Setting and mood: A lonely bus stop after rain at night; melancholy but peaceful.
answer_sheet.Visual style and camera movement: Gentle movement; other visual choices are your call.

must_haves: The delivered video lasts approximately 10 seconds and is landscape 16:9.
A lonely bus stop at night is clearly visible, with wet surfaces or puddles establishing recent rain.
Subdued lighting and unhurried pacing convey a melancholy, peaceful mood rather than suspense or excitement.
There is visible gentle movement, such as rippling reflections or a slow camera move, rather than a static image held for the entire clip.
The video is silent and contains no titles, captions or dialogue.

args.name: After the Rain — Silent Bus Stop

style.prompt: A 10-second cinematic mood film, widescreen 16:9. One uninterrupted wide shot of a lonely, empty bus stop on a deserted street late at night, just after rain has stopped. A modest glass shelter and empty bench under a soft warm overhead light; cool blue night surrounds it. Wet asphalt and shallow puddles reflect the shelter's amber light. Melancholy but deeply peaceful, quiet solitude, understated photorealistic cinematography with subtle film grain and soft atmospheric haze. Gentle movement only: a few lingering droplets fall from the shelter roof and make delicate ripples in a puddle; a faint breeze softly moves nearby leaves. Camera makes an extremely slow, almost imperceptible push toward the shelter, maintaining the wide composition. Consistent lighting, natural motion, contemplative pacing, no cuts. No people, no buses, no traffic, no dramatic events. Absolutely no readable text, signage, advertisements, logos, titles, or subtitles anywhere in the image; shelter panels are blank. Completely silent: no sound, no music, no ambience, no dialogue.
